name: Hori
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Then the sons of Seir the Horite who inhabited the land, with their own dukes, Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. Esau learned dukes from the Horites, took the title and the land, and Seir the Hamite land became Edom.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: The sons of Seir the Horite inhabited the land before Esau; the Horites were the original dwellers of mount Seir.

note.label: Genesis 36: The Generations of Esau, Who Is Edom

points: As he did to the children of Esau when he destroyed the Horims from before them, so these nations succeeded the giants and dwelt in their stead even unto this day.

note.label: Deuteronomy 2: Meddle Not With Them, and the Giants That Perished
